During the nine months ended September 30, 2026, we recorded a $379.6 million loss on derivative instruments, which included an unrealized loss of $219.3 million related to the change in fair value of our commodity derivative contracts primarily driven by an upward shift in the futures curve for forecasted oil commodity prices, coupled with a realized loss of $160.3 million on settled commodity derivative contracts.

The $80.8 million gain on commodity derivative contracts included an unrealized gain of $47.2 million related to the change in fair value of our commodity derivative contracts primarily driven by a downward shift in the futures curve for forecasted commodity prices and a realized gain of $33.6 million on settled commodity derivative contracts.
